title: QMA wire initialize handshake (CT-40)
description: MCP-style initialize params over JSON-RPC 2.0. Negotiates semver protocolVersion and capabilities; producer_id is assigned in the result. credential_ref is the broker reference only — never a resolved secret (FR-Q17).

protocolVersion.description: semver protocol version offered by the client

producer_id.description: Optional client-hint producer_id; server assigns the stable value in the result

credential_ref.description: Credential-Broker reference that authenticated the connection before protocol bytes; never a secret value
